name: Spec Search
description: Gives any system one search over a repository's records, standards and its own items, cheapest first, with the semantic search and the judge supplied by the caller, so no model or embedding lives in the library. Its first stage is the model-free lexical index, which stays available alone as the weighted-terms arms.
purpose: Find the records, standards and product items that a request concerns, cheapest first, each with the records it links to.
approach: Score the records lexically with the index's own formula, fuse that ranking with an optional semantic search the caller supplies, let only confident results through a gate with named thresholds, and let a judge the caller supplies choose at most once, keeping the candidates when it fails.
out_of_scope: Embeddings, vector stores, prompts and model calls, which the caller supplies; judging what the work is worth.
milestones: 1. Spec search correctness: the offline cases over the live records pass, 6 of 6. 2. Each adopter's search is a thin binding over this module and measures its own vector search and judge on its own records. 3. Spec index recall: for labelled requests the expected records appear in the top results, and the first stage's scan of all records stays a small fraction of the full records.
knowledge: Reciprocal rank fusion; field-weighted TF-IDF as the Quest AI runner uses for context cards; progressive disclosure; confidence-gated model use; the intent records' own link columns.
measures_of_success: Offline cases over the live records pass for the selected arm and the lexical baseline is no better; adopters hold no copy of the stages.
parameters: strategy (gated, judge-all, lexical); k_lexical and k_vector; max_ranked; expand; ranked_kinds and link_kinds; tags and tag_mode; the Gate thresholds; batch_size; unjudged_top; for the index stage k, how many records to return, and tier, how much of one record to show.
inputs: A request text, a list of views (from the index or from the caller's items), and optionally vector_search(text, k) and judge(task, lines, limit).
outputs: A Selection: ranked items best first with their linked items, the candidates, which search proposed each, the number of judge calls, the route and the no-solution cue.
effects: None of its own: it calls only the functions the caller injects. A failing vector search or judge leaves the lexical or fused answer.
usage_notes: Build views with views_from_index and views_from_items, call search(task, views, judge=..., vector_search=...). `esoi spec find TEXT` narrows by the index alone and `esoi spec show ID --tier N` reads one record. See docs/how-to/search-specs-and-items.md.
